description: This file contains unit tests for EventHub streaming cache miss scenarios in an Orleans-based application. It defines a test class 'EHStreamCacheMissTests' that configures a test cluster with specific stream provider settings, including cache eviction policies, event hub configuration, and data adapters. The class also includes nested configurator classes for silo and client setup.

classes.name: EHStreamCacheMissTests
classes.description: A test class for EventHub streaming cache miss scenarios, inheriting from StreamingCacheMissTests. It sets up the test environment with specific configurations for cache eviction, event hub, and data adapters.

classes.name: MySiloBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the Orleans silo with memory storage, event hub streams, cache eviction policies, and stream filters.

classes.name: MyClientBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the Orleans client with event hub stream settings and data adapters.
